usageNotes: Call this before initiating a QEMU live migration to determine whether the target node supports dbus-vmstate, which is required for migrating additional VM state (e.g., from QEMU guest agents or other dbus-connected helpers) without downtime. If `has-dbus-vmstate` returns false, any VM relying on dbus-vmstate transfer will fall back to offline migration or the state will be lost. Requires `Sys.Audit` on `/nodes/<node>`.

examples.summary: Check migration capabilities on node pve01 before live-migrating a VM

tips: Run this on the *destination* node — it tells you what that node can receive, not what the source node can send.
dbus-vmstate support requires the `dbus-broker` or `dbus-daemon` package and the qemu-server dbus-vmstate helper to be installed on the node.
A false result does not block migration entirely; it only means extra VM state carried via dbus will not transfer live.
